guards: Complements of section 6.2 WP-5 'PO close transitions' (plan :1149): closeOrder's own guard, the outstanding-lines refusal (purchase-order.service.js:633) and the short-close reason (:642), which precede the transition (WP5.mutations.poCloseTransitions; WP5ADJ Q7 "M-PCLg HEAD-only"). Run, not tallied in E6.
runsOn: HEAD only, before HR-C8 is implemented (FIXES['HR-C8'] empty). At HEAD the deep close probes (087-COM PO-C, 052-COM PO-O2, both partial) reach assertTransition under these mutants and are refused there (no partial -> closed row): nothing written. Once HR-C8 adds partial -> closed, the same probes would close the deep orders: never run then (wp5-mutation-evidence.js refuses to judge them on a baseline whose FIXES['HR-C8'] is set; WP5-RUN-PLAN.md section 14). Kept in a list of its own so that no post-fix invocation of the section 6.2 list can reach them.
note: Fields as in wp5-mutations.supply.json. Run one id per invocation, quoted and with a trailing comma ("--only=M-AVL,") and always with --lists=<key>: mutate-multi.js matches a value without a comma as a PREFIX (M-AVL would also run M-AVLa and M-AVLb; M-PCL0 also M-PCL0i and M-PCL0k; M-PCLg also M-PCLga and M-PCLgb), PowerShell drops an unquoted trailing comma, and ids such as M1 or G1 repeat across other lists.
